description: Holds weakly planner project details records, linked to crm projects, weakly planner headers.
business_purpose: Used to track and report weakly planner project details records, including amounts and quantities, for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: weaklyPlannerHeaderId
columns.description: Reference to the weakly planner headers linked to this weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: projectId
columns.description: Reference to the crm projects linked to this weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_ply_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Project ply sheet supplied of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_pvc_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Project pvc sheet supplied of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_total_sheet_supplied
columns.description: Project total sheet supplied of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_ply_sheet_planned
columns.description: Project ply sheet planned of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_pvc_sheet_planned
columns.description: Project pvc sheet planned of the weakly planner project detail.

columns.name: project_total_sheet_planned
columns.description: Project total sheet planned of the weakly planner project detail.

relationships.description: Each weakly planner project detail references one weakly planner headers (weakly planner header).
Each weakly planner project detail references one crm projects (project).

business_rules: Use project_total_sheet_supplied / project_total_sheet_planned for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to CRM Projects, Weakly Planner Headers through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Project Total Sheet Supplied per weakly planner project detail

common_queries: Weakly Planner Project Details by weakly planner headers
Weakly Planner Project Details by crm projects
Top weakly planner headers by project total sheet supplied

known_issues: project_total_sheet_supplied, project_total_sheet_planned are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name weaklyPlannerProjectDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting weakly planner project detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(project_total_sheet_supplied) for totals of project total sheet supplied.
To resolve names, join on: weaklyPlannerHeaderId = weaklyPlannerHeaders.id; projectId = CRM_Projects.Id.
